description: This file defines types, utility functions, and exports related to legacy configuration rules and migrations, with functions for handling records, merging, and parsing specific legacy configurations such as audio transcriptions and agent lists.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Returns the record if the value is a record, otherwise null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures a record exists at a given key in the root record, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Recursively merges missing properties from source into target, ignoring undefined and blocked keys.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Parses and maps a legacy audio transcription command object, validating structure and safety.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Extracts the list of agents from a given agents record.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from raw configuration, considering explicit defaults, routing config, or fallback.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent entry with a specific ID exists in the agent list, creating it if absent.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: Function to define a legacy config migration object; returns the provided migration spec.
